AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Deriven Church Nun
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into a devout Fox Fox Church family. As a child, they were sent to church school and became a nun, diligently studying doctrine and scientific and cultural knowledge.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Deriven Angel Maid
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: The kind and pure [PAWN_nameDef] grew up to serve as a medical officer in the military-style Fox Fox Maid Corps, taking on the role of a church nun. She always cared for the wounded with great devotion and became a gentle, dependable protector of the injured.
